requirement: Protocol section 16: blinded human review with two coders, at least 95 percent agreement on critical violations and Cohen kappa >= 0.80.
decision: E1-H1, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: the human review layer is removed. The entire audit is independent from human input. This supersedes D1 (bounded sample) and D2 (two named coders) of the same day.
consequence: No human review was performed and none will be. Four codes are permanently out of scope and E2_SCOPE_OVERREACH is narrowed to its frozen automated detector.
empirical_note: After decision D3 no case on either development split was flagged for human review, so the removed layer had nothing pending against it.
